items.title: ProxyOrbit launches Friday June 12, 2026
items.body:
The free Charles Proxy alternative for macOS ships **Friday June 12**.

- Capture HTTP/HTTPS from any Mac app
- Filter by method, status, host, path
- Real-time request log with body inspection
- Native Rust + Hyper + Tokio — under 30 MB at idle

No subscription, no $50 license. MIT licensed.
